lines.en: I walk the village with dye buckets on my back.
My robe is covered in colours.
I walk slowly over the sand.
I stop at a doorway to look in.
I follow the paved road.
The dye vials clink at my waist.
I pass the well toward the market.
I do not hurry; the load is heavy.

lines.zh: 我拉了拉被染色的袖子。
lines.en: I tug my stained sleeve.

lines.zh: 我走进沙漠村庄的巷子。
lines.en: I enter the alley of a desert village.

lines.zh: 我背着一卷新布往回走。
lines.en: I carry a roll of new cloth back.
I pass between the stalls.
My shadow falls on the drying cloth.

lines.zh: 我停在井边，打了一桶水。
lines.en: I stop at the well and draw water.

lines.zh: 我站着，手上有洗不掉的颜色。
lines.en: I stand with colours that will not wash off.
I count today's bottles.
I am looking at a fresh bolt of cloth.

lines.zh: 阳光让染料的颜色变亮。
lines.en: Sunlight brightens the dye.
I wipe the bottle mouths with a rag.
I am waiting for a customer.
I raise a hand against the glare.

lines.zh: 这地方很干，颜色不容易褪。
lines.en: It is dry here; colours fade slowly.

lines.zh: 我把一块布抖开又叠好。
lines.en: I shake out a cloth and fold it.
There is half a vat of blue left.
I stir the vat with a wooden paddle.
I check whether a cloth has dried.
There is colour under my nails.
I listen for anyone coming down the street.
Are you here to buy dye?

lines.zh: 五份染料换一颗绿宝石。
lines.en: Five portions of dye for one emerald.
Your clothes are far too plain.
I have pale blue and vermilion.
You have no emeralds on you, do you.

lines.zh: 别碰那口缸，会染上颜色。
lines.en: Don't touch that vat; it stains.
Which colour do you want? Say it.
I have worn this robe for ten years.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，走过沙漠。
lines.en: I know those boots; they crossed the desert.

lines.zh: 染上颜色洗不掉的，想清楚。
lines.en: Colour will not wash out; think carefully.

lines.zh: 你站得离我的货太近了。
lines.en: You are standing too near my stock.
This colour suits you, honestly.

lines.zh: 你要是不买，就往后站站。
lines.en: If you are not buying, stand back.
I do not give credit here.
Keep your hands off that row of bottles.

lines.zh: 你从哪儿来？沙漠里没什么人。
lines.en: Where are you from? Few come from the desert.
I step back and cover the crate.

lines.zh: 这一下撞倒了两个瓶子。
lines.en: That knocked over two bottles.

lines.zh: 我捂着胳膊，退到箱子边。
lines.en: I clutch my arm and back toward the crates.

lines.zh: 我的袍子上又多了一块颜色。
lines.en: Another colour joins my robe.

lines.zh: 别打，我这儿全是易碎的。
lines.en: Stop; everything here is fragile.

lines.zh: 我手一抖，染瓶磕在柜上。
lines.en: My hand jumps and a bottle knocks the counter.
Blood in the dye looks awful.
If you break stock, you pay.
These marks will not wash out.
I back to the inner doorway.
Red dye? My favourite.
These bottles are of good quality.
Let me hold it to the light.
Five for one, no haggling.
That colour is true.
I will take it and sell it slowly.

lines.zh: 还有别的颜色要出手吗。
lines.en: Any other colours you want to sell?
I am short of pale blue.
I will pay that price.
Done; take your emerald.
Sorry; too many bottles.

lines.zh: 你撞得我一个染瓶差点掉了。
lines.en: You nearly knocked a dye bottle loose.

lines.zh: 这一下我的袖子又添了一块颜色。
lines.en: That added another patch of colour to my sleeve.

lines.zh: 站稳，地上有洒出来的染料。
lines.en: Steady; there is spilled dye on the ground.

lines.zh: 我们各退一步，别弄脏你。
lines.en: We each step back; let's not stain you.
My goods are heavier than I am.
There is a bit of red on your shoulder.
No harm; dye does not bite.
I shuffle toward the wall with the crate.
Go around next time; this alley is narrow.
I speak only of trade.
Dye is more interesting than that.

lines.zh: 我在这里住下，是为了生意。
lines.en: I settled here for business.
You do not sound like a customer.
I set a bottle of red dye straight.
I do not meddle in that.
I still have a vat of cloth to dye.
Step aside; I am moving stock.
That subject has no value.
Better pick a colour.
I bend and pick the bottle up.

lines.zh: 手指上又多了一块颜色。
lines.en: Another patch of colour on my fingers.
This one is sealed; nothing spilled.
I slide the bottle back into my belt pouch.
A corner of this cloth is dirty.
I check the colour; it will do.
This bottle is cracked.
I set it under the counter.
I keep the rare colours back.
Good; into the crate.
This one does not look like a buyer.
I watch his hands.

lines.zh: 我把值钱的瓶子收起来。
lines.en: I put the valuable bottles away.
Are you buying, or robbing?
There is no one else in the alley.

lines.zh: 你盯着染缸，不是来买的。
lines.en: You are eyeing the vats, not here to buy.

lines.zh: 我把账本合上，往门边看。
lines.en: I close the ledger and glance at the door.
That thing in your hand is a blade, isn't it.
I slide the shears closer to my hand.
All these goods are mine.
You are still standing at the door.

lines.zh: 我把最贵的箱子上了锁。
lines.en: I lock the most expensive crate.
I wait for you to speak first.

lines.zh: 你靴子上全是路边的土。
lines.en: Your boots are caked with road dust.
I keep one hand flat on the counter's edge.
Spilled dye is hard to clean up.
My hand is under the counter.
No one outside will come to help.

lines.zh: 你看着我的货，不是看着我。
lines.en: You are looking at my goods, not at me.
I step back again.

lines.zh: 我抡起一个染瓶砸过去。
lines.en: I swing a dye bottle at you.
The bottle shatters in a blaze of red.

lines.zh: 这一下没打中，只溅了你一身。
lines.en: That missed and only splashed you.
I snatch the wooden rule from the counter.
You slash; I duck behind the vat.
I tip a vat of dye over.
The floor is slick; you cannot stand.

lines.zh: 我一手提着箱子往外挪。
lines.en: I carry the crate out with one hand.
You come after me and I shove back.

lines.zh: 我的东西不能被你拿走。
lines.en: You are not taking my goods.
I set up my stall at the village edge.
The dye bottles line up one by one.
The light is right; the colours look best.
This is desert village country.
I wipe the sign clean.
Children are watching from a distance.
I dry my hands on the apron.
I mean to sell a few bottles today.
The vats smell strong.
I sit and wait for customers.
Fire catches the cloth and it curls black.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下，瓶子碎了一地。
lines.en: I fall from the steps and bottles break.
Water dilutes all the dye.
The blast overturns my stall.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的肩，划开袍子。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my shoulder and tears the robe.

lines.zh: 那股力量让染缸变色了。
lines.en: That force changes the vat's colour.
No meal, and I cannot lift the crates.
Lightning hits the roof and the vats shake.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，手里还攥着瓶子。
lines.en: I fall with a bottle still in my hand.
